points.description: First limitation correctly stated with the correct technical term, matching the model answer: low material removal rate (MRR), OR limited nozzle life (nozzle wear), OR high cost.

Second, different limitation correctly stated with the correct technical term, from the model answer's set: low material removal rate (MRR), limited nozzle life (nozzle wear), high cost. Must be distinct from the first.

rubric.notes: Full marks need two different limitations from the model answer: low MRR, limited nozzle life (nozzle wear), high cost. Each is worth 1 mark and is all or nothing. A vague, generic or wrong statement (e.g. 'slow' with no mention of material removal, or an unrelated drawback) earns nothing for that point. If a student gives more than two items and any one is wrong, the wrong extra item costs a point.
